checks.detail: Exact rational finite laws of diameter one, seed 332.

checks.detail: Exact fractions, including Jensen consequence only when F second derivative is nonnegative.

checks.name: P0174 critical points with nonnegative curvature
checks.detail: All have profile >= 1; finite sampling is a check, not a universal proof.

checks.name: P0174 endpoint is a strict fourth-order maximum
checks.detail: Exact profile difference at y=3a; equality cannot be a separating minimum.

checks.name: P0174 stationary condition alone is insufficient
checks.detail: The symmetric endpoint law is stationary for y=2>3a; the curvature guard is essential.

checks.name: P0389 fixed-mass complement and hypergeometric variance
checks.detail: All 495 uniform four-subsets on 12 sites; 11 window sizes. Fixed total does not imply mesoscopic hyperuniformity.

checks.name: C0068 crossover inequality reversal
checks.detail: For d>6, V^(-2/d)/V^(-1/3)=V^(1/3-2/d) diverges. eps=V^-beta in the gap satisfies eps >> window and eps << crossover.
